description: Unified handoff snapshot of 12 design candidates and 2 ePCR clones with one shared WT reference; no new predictions or functional claims.
source_data_commit_note: commit of the tracked source files listed in sources/evidence; not the packaging code version

metrics_sources.note: candidate_metrics_summary.csv and mutation_local_metrics.csv are compiled from these existing result files; no new computation. A+B rows carry two independent comparisons: rmsd_vs_wt_* is the A+B-versus-WT supplementary comparison and rmsd_vs_parent_a_* is the A+B-versus-parent-A primary comparison; A/B candidates have rmsd_vs_parent_a_* marked 不适用. Local per-site displacement exists only for the ePCR clones; design candidates are marked 未计算. displacement_range_disjoint_from_baseline is a descriptive screen using the criterion: the minimum cross-sequence displacement is larger than the maximum same-clone self-baseline displacement at that position. It is not a significance test; the 9 cross-sequence model pairs and 3 self model pairs are statistically dependent, and the baseline is the variant's own sample dispersion, not a common WT-plus-variant upper bound. domain_centroid_distance_wt_reference_A is the ePCR-batch WT median (31.494 A, range 31.300-31.625 A over 3 models) for the clone rows.

derivation.computational_design: 11 non-WT design rows; protein edits and sequence SHA recomputed and verified against source
derivation.epcr_clone: NatV10/NatV89 from variants.csv; protein edits and sequence SHA recomputed and verified against source; DNA edits retained separately
derivation.coordinates: three diffusion samples (model_0/1/2) per candidate, converted from tracked .cif.gz archives; converted PDB sequence verified against the unified CSV; 14 candidates x 3 samples = 42 candidate coordinates
derivation.reference_coordinates: ePCR-batch WT samples kept as extra comparison reference; same sequence as unified WT but a different prediction batch

notes: A+B source_run/generation_candidate_id are inherited from parent A; not independent QVAE generation.
B1/B2 are mechanism-hypothesis designs and have empty source_run/generation_candidate_id.
Raw AB1 traces remain in raw wet-lab material; only tracked verification records are included.
Structure figures and coordinates are predictions, not activity, stability, expression, or ranking evidence.
The 12-design and ePCR model batches have different WT references/denominators and are not combined into one ranking.
Three diffusion samples per candidate are not independent seeds or replicates.
No experimentally validated activity or stability ranking exists.
